page: Microsoft Azure E8ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadsv7 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. The configuration includes 8 virtual CPUs, which map to 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The processor features 48 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 (AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16) and cryptography standards like AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. The server is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It also features 472 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable. No GPUs are included.

In benchmark evaluations, the E8ads_v7 demonstrates strong single-core performance alongside moderate multi-core capabilities. Single-core stress-ng CPU tests and single-threaded gzip compression (40.23 GB/sec) place the server in the top 10% tier. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression also registers in the top tier at 18.26 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core performance metrics, such as the multi-core stress-ng CPU test (14665.45) and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (68.16 GB/sec), fall within the average middle 50% range. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance, with cached small-block reads at 862.64 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads and writes at 48.39 GB/sec and 33.62 GB/sec respectively. Passmark database operations (5122.12) and Redis SET operations (14.2 million operations/sec) also align with average tier expectations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E8ads_v7 offers a high memory density relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for workloads requiring substantial RAM without the cost overhead of additional vCPUs. The inclusion of 472 GB of local storage provides built-in capacity for temporary data, though the lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses requires external network configuration. Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, this server is suited for memory-intensive applications, database operations, caching layers like Redis, and single-threaded processing tasks that benefit from its top-tier single-core performance.
